answers.note: Импульс достигает всех сократительных клеток желудочков примерно за 75 мс.

currentCard.explanation: Волокна Пуркинье быстро распределяют электрическое возбуждение по миокарду желудочков. Благодаря этому сокращение желудочков начинается организованно, преимущественно от верхушки к основанию сердца.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: FIX unique-key wording: 19.2L74 explicitly grounds Purkinje spread to ventricular contractile cells, so key0 is correct. L58 assigns NORMAL rhythm toSA andL66–L68 assign pause toAV. But slot3 merely says conducting an impulse “через межжелудочковую перегородку”, with no distinct endpoints or upstream transit segment. L74 says Purkinje extend throughout ventricular myocardium, while19.1L106/L108 define septa as myocardial extensions. Thus sourceL71 identifying the His course does not establish broadslot3 is false of Purkinje. Need an exclusive normal-path segment, not just a location inside ventricular myocardium. Grammar and comparable conduction-role category otherwise pass.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Волокна Пуркинье быстро распределяют электрическое возбуждение по миокарду желудочков. Благодаря этому сокращение желудочков начинается организованно, преимущественно от верхушки к основанию сердца.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: L74 says Purkinje have fast conduction and spread impulse to ventricular contractile cells throughout myocardium from apex toward septum/base. L75 explains contraction begins at apex and travels toward base. Both explanation sentences preserve this electrical-to-mechanical sequence rather than confusing pacemaker initiation with ventricular distribution.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Импульс достигает всех сократительных клеток желудочков примерно за 75 мс.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: L74 explicitly says impulse reaches all ventricular muscle cells in about75ms. Note preserves approximation and ventricular-cell endpoint. This is Purkinje-distribution stage, not the SA-to-ventricle total225ms atL75 and not AV pause100ms. Quantitative spread interval is a concrete extra own-option fact beyond merely transferring excitation.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Синоатриальный узел с наибольшей частотой деполяризации инициирует синусовый, или нормальный, ритм.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS note truth/usefulness: L58 statesSA has highest inherent depolarisation rate and initiates sinus/normal rhythm; L94–L96 distinguish its faster pacemaking from slower latent downstream generators. Note correctly supplies actual normal-rhythm origin for the offered false role.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Проведение через атриовентрикулярный узел занимает примерно 100 мс; эта пауза позволяет предсердиям завершить сокращение.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: L62 andL66–L68 explicitly describe critical AV delay about100ms before bundle transmission, allowing atrial contraction/pumping to finish. Note keeps approximate duration and purpose, without conflating that interval with75ms ventricular distribution.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Пучок Гиса проходит через межжелудочковую перегородку и делится на правую и левую ножки.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS note fact but insufficient disambiguation of its ANSWER: L71 explicitly describes His bundle proceeding through interventricular septum before right/left branch division. This makes the note true and useful about that route. It does not make the broader answer’s location-only conduction predicate exclusive toHis or false for the Purkinje ventricular network; note cannot silently add absent answer endpoints.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: Distinguishing terminalPurkinje ventricular distribution from SA normal pacemaking, AV delay and His upstream transit requires specific cardiac-conduction physiology. Knowledge of the ordinary blood pump is insufficient. Named adjacent stages provide meaningful elimination, satisfying HARD without arbitrary numeric recall; the actual question does not ask its note’s75ms.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Impulse reaches all ventricular contractile cells in about75ms during the Purkinje distribution stage.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: Neither prompt nor role key specifies spread duration. L74 supplies the quantitative distribution fact; L75’s225ms is a separate total fromSA initiation, not a contradiction or replacement value.

defects.finding: The literal option names conduction through a myocardial location, not an exclusive His transit stage. Purkinje distribute through ventricular myocardium (19.2L74), and interventricularseptum is myocardial tissue (19.1L106/L108). L71 attributing one such route toHis does not show it cannot describe a part of Purkinje conduction. Question asks a role, so a merely less-specific true-compatible role is an invalid distractor. This is ambiguity, not a claim that source explicitly labels slot3 the principalPurkinje function.
defects.minimumDirectedFix: Author should replace onlyslot3 role with unambiguous normal-path endpoints belonging toHis, e.g. “Передают импульс от AV-узла к правой и левой ножкам пучка Гиса”, grounded inL63/L71. Preserve frozenkey0/HARD and retain good note/evidence as applicable; verify new literal against complete source and affected MAIN peers. Reviewer proposes direction, does not editcatalog.
